findings.snippet: returns the first widget whose `Name` equals `name` under an ordinal, case-sensitive comparison (`string.Equals(..., StringComparison.Ordinal)`)
findings.message: The epic requires a client to look a widget up by the name it created it with in any case or spacing, but the planned FindByName (wired to GET /widgets/by-name/{name} in Program.cs) is ordinal and case-sensitive and does not normalise its input, so FindByName("Alpha") for a widget created as "Alpha" returns 404.
